answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Verified glazier registration with glazing federation attestation stops them at the door: a registration the federation renews after assessed installs, which means the vault of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the copper is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the summit for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
